bug_description: Merchant can see Super Admin dashboard link in navigation bar after login
ground_truth: RBAC violation — Merchant role should only access merchant dashboard. Super Admin navigation link must be hidden for Merchant and Customer roles per the role-based access control spec.

bug_description: No error message shown after account is locked following 3 failed login attempts
ground_truth: After 3 failed login attempts the account should lock for 5 minutes and display a clear lockout message to the user per the security features spec.

bug_description: Customer can access merchant product management page by navigating directly to the URL
ground_truth: Unauthorized users must be automatically redirected from protected routes per RBAC spec. Customer role must not access Merchant product management pages.

bug_description: Role badge not displayed in navigation bar after login
ground_truth: The navigation bar must display a role badge for the logged-in user as part of the smart navigation bar UI feature per the Frontend UI spec.

bug_description: Super Admin cannot see the View User Details button on user management page
ground_truth: Super Admin must be able to view user details page per the User Management spec. The View User Details button must be visible and functional for Super Admin role.

bug_description: Login API returns 200 with incorrect password instead of 401
ground_truth: POST /api/auth/login must return 401 for invalid credentials per the API spec. Returning 200 with wrong password is a critical authentication security failure.

bug_description: Register API returns 500 when email already exists instead of 400
ground_truth: POST /api/auth/register must return 400 when email already exists per the API spec. A 500 response indicates an unhandled server error instead of proper input validation.

bug_description: Refresh token endpoint returns 200 with expired token instead of 403
ground_truth: POST /api/auth/refresh must return 403 for invalid or expired refresh tokens per the API spec. Accepting expired tokens is a security vulnerability.

bug_description: Logout endpoint returns 200 without a valid bearer token
ground_truth: POST /api/auth/logout requires bearer token authentication per the API spec. Returning 200 without a valid token means the auth middleware is not enforcing security correctly.

bug_description: Merchant dashboard does not show total products count
ground_truth: Merchant dashboard must display total products as part of store insights per the Merchant Features spec. Missing metric breaks the dashboard completeness requirement.
